blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water partnered with the United Nations Global Compact Network Philippines (GCNP) to organize a Peer Learning Session on Environment focused on climate resilience, water stewardship, circularity, and environmental responsibility. Held on Sept. 24 at the MWSS Administration Building in Balara, Quezon City, the session brought together sustainability leaders from the private sector and academe to exchange insights and practical approaches to environmental sustainability. Opening the event, Sarah Bergado, Sustainability Director of Manila Water and GCNP Board Trustee, emphasized the importance of collaboration in advancing sustainable business practices.
